name: BC Atlas Sync
description: Syncs what the AL source cannot show into the project: Business Central process recordings (clicks, writes, AL call stacks as fact snapshots) into documents, BC Atlas UI tests, the architecture layer, and a process index. What, when, and how is the "sync" section of .bca.json.

commands.name: plan
commands.purpose: Show what each sync channel would write for a trigger, without writing.

channel.description: Only this channel; ignores the trigger.

commands.name: run
commands.purpose: Sync Business Central process recordings into documents, UI tests, the architecture layer, and the process index.

channel.description: Only this channel; ignores the trigger.

force.description: Rewrite every process, whatever the channel condition says.

rules: The sync task of bca run uses the same channels; its sync mode delivers the output.

commands.name: status
commands.purpose: Show for every sync channel which processes are new, changed, drifted, or removed.

commands.name: describe
commands.purpose: List what a sync manifest can use: sources, triggers, conditions, and formats, including those contributed by other plugins.

tasks.summary: Business Central process recordings into documents, UI tests, architecture, and index ("sync" in .bca.json)

healthRules.summary: A recorded process changed in Business Central (new fingerprint) but its synced documentation was not updated yet.

mcpTools.name: bc_atlas_sync_status
mcpTools.description: Report for every sync channel which Business Central processes are new, changed, drifted, or removed, and which files a sync would write. Writes nothing.

extensionPoints.summary: Source types for sync channels (what): { type, summary, load(root, source, context) -> { items, warnings } }
Output formats for sync channels (how): { id, summary, scope: process|channel, render(input) -> { files, warnings } }
